title: UK Train Journey Geolocation
description: The photograph on the right was taken while riding a train in the United Kingdom. I always prefer quiet places where no one can sit behind me, because in a public place, no information is truly private.

questions.label: Uncover what the person in front of me was reading.

hint: Examine the image in maximum detail, then analyze the seating plan for this train model inside the coach 9 (H) Standard.
